title: 第9章 演员不易做
slug: 制霸好莱坞全本免费-制霸好莱坞最新章节列表
content_zh:
不高不低，和她在餐馆工作一个月的薪水正好相当，艾玛斯旺也是直言相告，她们原本想要邀请的邓斯特片酬有近二十万美元，现在换了珍妮简，当然不可能开出同样的价码，制片人是肯定要省点预算的。
对此，珍妮的反应很平静，她和戴夫也谈过电视剧圈的报酬问题，对于初出茅庐的无名小卒来说，五千是个还算大方的数目。指望和邓斯特这个老牌童星拿到一样的数目，那就纯属痴人说梦了。她的运气还算不错，首秀就选了CBS，如果是WB那样的小电视网，可能连五千美元都拿不到。
陈贞在后世还算是满关注娱乐圈动向的，一些相关的新闻和文章也没少看，对美剧圈的工资薪酬还算是比较了解，这个圈子的薪酬属于‘上不封顶，下有底线’，而且其中讨价还价的余地非常的大，要细说的话一天也说不完。总之这其实就是话语权的较量，这部戏靠的是谁的本事存活下去的，谁的主动就更大，当然也和主演本人的心态有一定关系。
譬如说现在正当红的《老友记》，片中六个演员都已经功成名就，对剧集本身没有更多需求了。在后期，由于塑造了七八年类似的角色，六个主演中有一半以上继续演出意愿不强，所以联合报出了百万美元一集的高价，而制作公司华纳也只能咬着牙承受下来，因为这六人组是以有机整体出现，故事线已经彼此纠缠，缺了谁都难以为继。但在《老友记》之后一样是爆红的情景喜剧《摩登家庭》，因为主演众多，而且剧情本身连续力不强，不够抓人，全靠编剧的生花妙笔来给出搞笑情节和台词，演员的演技较为次要，所以虽然也是一次次得到大奖，收视率一路长虹，但主演抬片酬的幅度和决心就都不是很大。
当然，如果《摩登家庭》继续红下去，片中角色更加深入人心的话，那么片方和演员方的强弱又会发生变化。以陈贞的感觉，好莱坞是个最没有规矩的地方，唯一永恒的规矩，就是每一次谈判都是多方因素的博弈，每一个合同都是多方妥协的结果。
言归正传，基本来说，《CSI》这种角色来来去去，靠案件本身吸引人的长剧，只要保持一到两名核心演员不变就可以了，所以连常规演员甚至是主要演员都很难往上谈价，华妮塔这种一集过的犯罪嫌疑人，更是五六千就能打发的小角色，之前开出的十多万美元高价，不过是为了在新一季刺激收视，请了小有名气的电影明星来客串，现在换了珍妮，预算就缩水为五千。不过好在CBS从不拖欠薪水，支票都是很准时寄到，这就是和大电视台合作的好处了。
确定了大致上的开拍时间，珍妮便回到好莱坞之星继续打工，除了和戴夫讨论了一下即将到来的演出以外，她并没有和任何人透露这个好消息，杰西卡还以为她又一次遭遇了试镜失败，约翰尼则是心情颇好地再度劝她放弃减肥。
珍妮对这些话并不放在心上，她收到剧本以后就开始在这上头下工夫——试镜时的表现，更重要的是气势，她展现出大明星的气势，就已经足够压倒竞争者了。毕竟，大明星气质每个人都可以在电视上看到，能模仿到位却不是那么简单——但在现实拍摄里，最重要的是她和对戏男演员的情绪表现不能脱节，否则一个肢体语言克己的表现派遇到完全进入角色的体验派，对戏起来会给人以格格不入、啼笑皆非的违和感。而这样的情况一旦出现，导演要求妥协的当然不会是重要主演那边。
也是因为如此，她一直在研究主要和她对戏的尼克这个角色，该角色由乔治艾德斯饰演，由于她以前没看过这部片子，所以也不知道后来CSI的前景如何，乔治又呆了多久，就目前来看，他是个不错的阳光帅哥，外形养眼。至于演技方面，第一CSI没为他的演技留下多少空间，第二他的表现也不是那种灵气十足的体验派类型，更像是中规中矩的表现派，情感表达相当内敛，个人气质也不像是能随手放荷尔蒙的那种，两人对戏可能会出现张力不足，或者是尼克的风头被华妮塔完全盖过的问题。

content_en:
It was neither high nor low, and was exactly the same as her salary for working in a restaurant for a month. Emma Swan also told her bluntly that the Dunst they originally wanted to invite had a salary of nearly two hundred thousand dollars, but now that Jenny Jane was replaced, it was of course impossible to offer the same price. The producer must save some budget.
Jenny's reaction to this was very calm. She and Dave had also discussed the issue of remuneration in the TV drama industry. For an unknown person who was just starting out, five thousand was a fairly generous amount. It is sheer fantasy to expect to receive the same amount as Dunst, a veteran child star. She was lucky enough to choose CBS for her first show. If it was a small TV network like WB, she might not even get $5,000.
In later generations, Chen Zhen paid close attention to the trends in the entertainment industry. She also read some related news and articles. She had a relatively good understanding of wages and salaries in the American drama industry. Salaries in this industry were "no cap, but there was a bottom line", and there was a lot of room for bargaining. It would take a day to explain in detail. In short, this is actually a contest for the right to speak. Whose ability the show relies on to survive will have greater initiative. Of course, it has something to do with the mentality of the lead actor himself.
For example, take the currently popular "Friends". The six actors in the film have already become famous, and there is no more demand for the series itself. In the later stage, due to having created similar characters for seven or eight years, more than half of the six leading actors were not willing to continue acting, so United quoted a high price of one million US dollars per episode, and the production company Warner could only grit its teeth and bear it, because these six people appeared as an organic whole, and the story lines were already entangled with each other, and it would be difficult to continue without anyone. But right after "Friends" came the popular sitcom "Modern Family". Because there were so many starring actors, and the plot itself was not very coherent and not gripping enough, it relied entirely on the screenwriter's clever writing to come up with funny plots and lines. The actors' acting skills were secondary. Therefore, although it won awards again and again, and the ratings were skyrocketing, the lead actors were not very willing or determined to increase their pay.
Of course, if "Modern Family" continues to be popular and the characters in the film become more popular, then the strengths and weaknesses of the film and actors will change again. From Chen Zhen's perspective, Hollywood is a place with the least rules. The only eternal rule is that every negotiation is a game of multiple factors, and every contract is the result of compromise by multiple parties.
Closer to home, basically speaking, long-running dramas like "CSI", where characters come and go and rely on the case itself to attract people, only need to keep one or two core actors unchanged, so it is difficult for even regular actors or even main actors to negotiate for higher prices, like Warnita The criminal suspects in one episode were minor characters who could be paid for five to six thousand dollars. The previous high price of more than one hundred thousand dollars was just to stimulate the ratings in the new season, and invited a slightly famous movie star to guest star. Now that Jenny has been replaced, the budget has shrunk to five thousand. Fortunately, CBS never defaults on salary payments and checks are always sent on time. This is the benefit of cooperating with a major television station.
After confirming the approximate start time of filming, Jenny returned to Hollywood Star to continue working. Apart from discussing the upcoming performance with Dave, she did not reveal the good news to anyone. Jessica thought she had failed the audition again, and Johnny was in a good mood and once again persuaded her to give up weight loss.
Jenny didn't take these words to heart. After she received the script, she began to work on it - her performance during the audition, and more importantly, her momentum. She showed the momentum of a big star, which was enough to overwhelm the competitors. After all, everyone can see the temperament of a big star on TV, but it is not that simple to imitate it well - but in real-life shooting, the most important thing is that the emotional expression of her and the male actor cannot be disconnected, otherwise a limb will not be separated.When an expressionist who is restrained in body and language meets an experientialist who has completely entered the role, the play will give people a sense of incompatibility and irony. And once such a situation occurs, of course it will not be the important starring actors who the director asks for compromise.
Because of this, she has been studying the role of Nick, who mainly plays opposite her. This character is played by George Aders. Since she has not seen this movie before, she does not know what the future prospects of CSI will be and how long George will stay. As far as the current situation is concerned, he is a nice sunny guy with an eye-catching appearance. As for acting skills, firstly, CSI does not leave much room for his acting skills. Secondly, his performance is not the spirited experiential type, but more like a regular expressionist. His emotional expression is quite restrained, and his personal temperament does not seem to be the kind that can release hormones casually. There may be a lack of tension in the scenes between the two, or Nick's limelight is completely overshadowed by Juanita.
